summary.headline: Monthly Celestial Omens
summary.text: Monthly weather and omen predictions for December through May, linking thunder, lunar halos, eclipsed or weakened sunlight, falling or disappearing stars, earthquakes, winds, and celestial signs with harvests, rain, cold, locusts, deaths, wars, and rulers’ falls.
